the proposed text detection system is effective in detecting text in mobile video.
the proposed method outperforms the state of the arts methods in terms of precision, recall, F-measure, and misdetection rate.

In summary, our research is concerned with

the following aspects: (i) a new method for text detection in low quality mobile video; (ii) a new method to separate text components from non text ones; (iii) a new method that can extract multioriental texts in a single step.
the development of a new text detection method for mobile video.
the development of a robust text detection algorithm for mobile video images.

the proposed method is effective in detecting text in video captured by the mobile camera, which is the main contribution of this work.
the proposed method performs very well in terms of precision, F-measures and misdetection rate on all datasets.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have proposed a novel method based on fractals and optical flow for text detection in low resolution mobile videos.
the proposed method can detect text components from low resolution mobile video with arbitrary orientations and complex background.
we introduce fractal properties for text detection, which is a novel approach.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed method can be used for text detection in low resolution video and arbitrary oriented text detection in natural scene images.
